name: Do I need to be present during appliance installation in my Berkeley home?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to be present during appliance installation in my Berkeley home?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it's not strictly necessary for you to be present for the entire appliance installation in your Berkeley home, it can be beneficial for making on-the-spot decisions or answering questions if unforeseen issues arise. If you cannot be present, we ensure that a project manager or a trusted team member is on site to oversee the process and communicate any developments to you. Your presence is mostly a matter of personal preference and availability.
acceptedAnswer.description: You are not strictly required to be present during appliance installation, though it can be beneficial for on-the-spot decisions; a project manager will oversee the process.
